name: Comic Book Art
visualIdentity: Explicit: Drawing and Illustration category, explicit provenance. Uses panel layouts, bold contours, exaggerated poses, speed lines, and purposeful sound-effect lettering. One coherent drawing and printing language is required, with no mixing of conflicting comic traditions.
suitableUses: Explicit: narrative panels and character action. Source-suggested hybrids target explainer comics and product or research summaries told by a character guide, plus action trailers, social cutdowns, and title sequences. Other uses are unspecified.
limitations: Explicit: dialogue must stay accurate and readable, and conflicting comic traditions must not be mixed. Hybrid avoid-notes: no glossy gradients, distorted scales, speed lines on static values, constant type jitter, or manga and western SFX mixing. Rough.js hachure does not replace halftone printing.
palette: Suggested only, for new artwork when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #FFF2D9, foreground #1C2230, accent_1 #C9403C, accent_2 #E1B744, accent_3 #3768A1. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background is 14.35:1. accent_1 at 4.427:1 is decorative only. accent_2 with foreground is 8.372:1. accent_3 with background is 5.183:1. Supplied exact colors override these tokens. Colors must not be automatically altered, and contrast must be rechecked on composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Explicit: motion comes from panel staging, exaggerated poses, speed lines, and impact lettering, with elements allowed to cross panel borders. Key-pose changes and real text control reading rhythm. Inferred: motion-016 (manga opening) suits this style when subjects and text are separable. Pupil-only gaze and ambient wiggle are weaker fits. Motion-012, 013, and 015 are conditional. Video state must derive from composition time, and interactive delivery is optional.
audio: Unspecified by the style. Task-specific suggestions may include background music, voiceover, sung vocals, sound effects, ambience, or silence, with no fixed genre or mandatory layer. Motion-016 suggests short impact accents and page or ink sounds. Its gallery demos are silent. Speech must stay intelligible, and audio must not clip or compete with narration.
assetRequirements: Explicit: separate panels, characters, lettering, and masks as distinct layers. Layered PNGs need alpha transparency, consistent dimensions, clear naming, and inspection before composition. Frame sequences need numbering. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Comic lettering must use hand-lettered forms, not generic display fonts. Font files are unspecified.
combinations: Explicit: Comic Book Art alone suits narrative panels. Hybrid style-097 places charts, maps, and sequence diagrams inside inked panels, using only resolved palette and matching contour weight. Hybrid style-093 adds kinetic lettering for SFX, captions, and titles, with accents on key poses only. Motion-016 pairs naturally. Motion-006 gaze needs eye layers or a rig.
productionApproach: Explicit division: SVG is the primary style renderer, with optional PixiJS sprites and Rough.js sketch contours. GSAP is the paused seekable motion engine, and Motion is optional. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for assembly, timing, audio sync, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and that reason must be recorded. Duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and frame rate are unspecified; source values are optional examples.
